{{Update|date=November 2023}}

This article presents data on agricultural employment in European countries.

== Map ==

The map uses the latest data from the World Bank as of August 2016.<ref>{{cite web|title=Employment in agriculture (% of total employment) |url=http://databank.worldbank.org/data/reports.aspx?source=2&series=SL.AGR.EMPL.ZS&country=|website=The World Bank|accessdate=9 August 2016}}</ref> Numbers are in percentage.
